title: The characteristic polynomial on a finite locally free module is multiplicative on direct sums
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $M_1,M_2$ $A$-modules and $n_1,n_2\ge0$ such that for $k=1,2$ there are $f^{(k)}_1,\dots,f^{(k)}_{r_k}\in A$ generating the unit ideal with $(M_k)_{f^{(k)}_i}$ free of rank $n_k$ over $A_{f^{(k)}_i}$, and let $\varphi_k:M_k\to M_k$ be $A$-linear. Then $M=M_1\oplus M_2$ is finite locally free of constant rank $n_1+n_2$ (the products $f^{(1)}_if^{(2)}_j$ generate the unit ideal and $M_{f^{(1)}_if^{(2)}_j}$ is free of rank $n_1+n_2$), and $\mathrm{CharPol}_A(\varphi_1\oplus\varphi_2:M\to M)=\mathrm{CharPol}_A(\varphi_1:M_1\to M_1)\cdot\mathrm{CharPol}_A(\varphi_2:M_2\to M_2)$ in $A[T]$ [def-weil-pbc-charpoly-locally-free].

lean.statement: theorem locallyFreeCharpoly_prodMap {A : Type u} {M₁ : Type v₁} {M₂ : Type v₂} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module A M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module A M₂] {n₁ n₂ r₁ r₂ : ℕ} (f₁ : Fin r₁ → A) (f₂ : Fin r₂ → A) (hgen₁ : Ideal.span (Set.range f₁) = ⊤) (hgen₂ : Ideal.span (Set.range f₂) = ⊤) (hfree₁ : ∀ i : Fin r₁, ∃ _e : Module.Basis (Fin n₁) (Localization.Away (f₁ i)) (LocalizedModule.Away (f₁ i) M₁), True) (hfree₂ : ∀ j : Fin r₂, ∃ _e : Module.Basis (Fin n₂) (Localization.Away (f₂ j)) (LocalizedModule.Away (f₂ j) M₂), True) (φ₁ : M₁ →ₗ[A] M₁) (φ₂ : M₂ →ₗ[A] M₂) : let g : Fin (r₁ * r₂) → A := fun k ↦ f₁ (finProdFinEquiv.symm k).1 * f₂ (finProdFinEquiv.symm k).2; ∃ (hggen : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤) (hgfree : ∀ k : Fin (r₁ * r₂), ∃ _e : Module.Basis (Fin (n₁ + n₂)) (Localization.Away (g k)) (LocalizedModule.Away (g k) (M₁ × M₂)), True), locallyFreeCharpoly g hggen hgfree (φ₁.prodMap φ₂) = locallyFreeCharpoly f₁ hgen₁ hfree₁ φ₁ * locallyFreeCharpoly f₂ hgen₂ hfree₂ φ₂
